assumption: Apply tem/agent-iterations/PROTOCOL.md's experiment-complete assumption: declared model runs and human-review collection are assumed competently completed for design assessment, without assuming favorable scores, significance, answerability, human agreement, ranking reversals, or empirical superiority. Missing population measurements alone are not grounds for rejection. No inference or collection was performed for this review.
scope: Independent final simulated CVPR review of the frozen research, actual rendered PDFs, figure provenance, and packaged release. Not an official conference decision or certification of a later commit or external deployment.

criteria.name: Scientific contribution and distinction from closest prior work
criteria.assessment: Useful exact-cost, resource/work, and nonterminal-repair diagnostic composition, not a new planner or first interactive brick-construction benchmark. Current primary abstracts confirm substantial overlap with interactive construction, multi-step planning, failure diagnosis, and diverse-brick pose estimation. Novelty remains incremental.

criteria.name: Construct validity and input-ability relationship
criteria.assessment: Inventory-matched support-context interventions and original registered poses genuinely remove the former global-count confound. Explicit support-only wording accurately limits the retained primary cohort; unchanged motion blockers do not establish changed path-clearance reasoning. Pixel distinction is not perceptual sufficiency.

criteria.name: Dataset depth, sampling, diversity, dependence, and held-out evaluation
criteria.assessment: The 81 newly admitted sources and explicit source/admission censuses add meaningful breadth. Primary visual replication remains 36 pairs, 18 interventions, and 12 sources, including 24 pairs from nine held-out sources; 98/116 qualified interventions are zero-yield. Source-level units and selection limits remain explicit.

criteria.name: Ground truth, scoring, edge cases, failure denominators, and shortcuts
criteria.assessment: Exact labels, joint-pair denominators, calibration separation, valid ties, and source-weighting remain unchanged from the independently tested design. The current bank-bound full audit passes all 8441 records, 650 tables with 61093730 state entries, and 308 pairs. Shallow controls and restricted deterministic-ceiling caveats remain prominent.

criteria.name: Experiment design and uncertainty under the completion assumption
criteria.assessment: Matched static, active, and structured conditions, assignment coverage, and source-level uncertainty can support interpretable positive, null, or negative outcomes. No favorable empirical result is required for the bounded construction claim, and none is inferred. Answerability, visual benefits, human-model gaps, and nonlocal repair advantages remain conditional.

criteria.name: Reproducibility, traceable figures, and faithful source geometry
criteria.assessment: Whole-source gates and preserved original evidence remain intact. Final figures, captions, PDFs, editable sources, archive inventory, export inputs, browser inputs, and live download bytes correspond. The runtime-only archive correctly discloses that source construction requires the matching checkout. Full source/mesh audits, browser execution, extracted-runtime execution, and Overleaf compilation are reused as prior completed evidence rather than claimed as freshly rerun.

criteria.name: Narrative, readable examples, and CVPR format/fit
criteria.assessment: The final seven-page paper is readable, uses embedded Nimbus/Times text at nominal 10pt, and gives source-bound geometry and repair examples. The 64-page supplement includes an intact 25-page gallery and flowing metric/source table. A minor chart-legend color defect remains. Public preprint formatting is not a certification of actual submission metadata or future venue preflight.

issues.summary: Both legend swatches in the supplementary structural-control bar chart are blue, although the plotted completion and optimal-completion series use light and dark green.
issues.why_it_matters: The color key does not identify the plotted quantities reliably. This does not invalidate the counts, denominators, or independently labeled main structural-control table, so it is nonblocking. It is newly identified in the final visual review, not established as a newly introduced scientific regression.
closure_test: Use actual plotted handles or explicit legend patches with the two series colors.
Regenerate the chart and supplement only in a separately authorized snapshot.
Inspect the actual compiled PDF to confirm both legend swatches match the corresponding bars and the tabulated values.

issues.summary: Fixed static multiview and separately charged active-view closure retained; empirical answerability is not assumed.
issues.why_it_matters: No observation-contract change reintroduces the demonstrated identical-default-input defect. The publication case uses an actual certified distinct isometric view; this still does not prove human or model sufficiency.
closure_test: Retain native pair-specific certificates and static/active budget separation.
Certify newly claimed seeds and preprocessing conditions before stronger answerability claims.

issues.summary: Calibration exclusion, valid tie sets, and missing-variant denominators are unchanged.
issues.why_it_matters: The 50 all-correct calibration rows do not inflate the 6970 discriminative assignments, and missing assigned variants cannot disappear from averaging.
closure_test: Preserve the unchanged calibration/tie/missing-assignment tests and the denominator table in later snapshots.

issues.summary: Inverse-last control and separate repair-cohort reporting remain closed in their bounded scope.
issues.why_it_matters: The public inverse solves 2260/3829 questions, with 1487 inverse-suboptimal and 82 inverse-unavailable cases. The paper does not infer nonlocal reasoning from lag alone. The final figure transparently shows one certified inverse-suboptimal case.
closure_test: Keep cohort-specific outcomes and zero credit for unavailable inverses.
Require actual relevant-cohort evidence for stronger nonlocal-recovery claims.

issues.summary: Privileged shallow controls and operation-length interpretation remain explicit.
issues.why_it_matters: Depth-one uniform-tie accuracy is approximately 97.35%; 100-expansion A* completes 4075/4263 runs and full closure A* completes all 4263 optimally. The bank's exact long traces therefore do not establish necessary deep planning.
closure_test: Retain strong controls, tie statistics, privileged-input labels, and D1-D4 as operation-length bins.

issues.summary: The original count/type-color confound and insufficient construction-level replication remain repaired for the bounded matched-support diagnostic.
issues.why_it_matters: There are 36 primary pairs across 18 interventions and 12 sources, including 24 pairs across nine held-out sources, with matched inventory, registered poses, state, goal, capacity, jobs, and plan. Both exact labels are required. Source-fidelity exclusions remain preserved. The new wording accurately limits the cohort to unsupported-assembly failures with unchanged motion blockers.
closure_test: Preserve exact matching, shared legal prefixes, both labels, source-level weighting, and historical-unmatched separation.
Keep all six full-source failures excluded without original-source replacement or modification.
Reopen if this support-only cohort is promoted to evidence of general mechanics, changed path clearance, required long-horizon reasoning, or universal shortcut immunity without new evidence.

issues.summary: The repaired acquired-frame metadata occupancy channel is unchanged and its prior closure is retained.
issues.why_it_matters: Prior noninterference/restart/retry checks remain applicable on unchanged code. Fresh browser-input bindings match the completed evidence. Practice metadata, routing-ID memorization, and released private evaluator data still require explicit policy isolation.
closure_test: Keep state-independent frame IDs and the existing noninterference tests.
Do not treat address-normalized certificates as universal metadata security; isolate the policy host.

issues.summary: Final repair-figure readability and correspondence are now independently inspected, extending the design round's inherited closure.
issues.why_it_matters: Readable P002/P013 callouts, the complete seven-operation repair, and the nine-operation inverse-first comparison communicate the actual certified example. The PDF embeds the exact source figure, and the stored history/cost records match the bank. This remains an oracle replay, not a model result.
closure_test: Satisfied: inspect actual final callouts and full repair trace, match the 7-versus-9 comparison to the bank, and verify pixel-identical PDF embedding and provenance.
Preserve the same checks for future regenerated figures.

residual_limitations: The primary visual inference unit is nine held-out sources, not 97 active sources or 7020 probe rows. Only 18 of 116 qualified interventions yield retained pairs, so the cohort is mechanism-conditioned.

Primary illegal members fail through stud support, with matched motion-blocker relations. Conflicts occur at positions 3-7, including 24/36 at operation three; this does not establish required long-horizon simulation.
Strong privileged shallow/search controls and the 2260/3829 inverse-last baseline constrain difficulty and nonlocal-repair interpretations.

Restricted deterministic ceilings do not exclude local spatial/support cues, silhouette, framing, source-template recognition, stochastic policies, routing-address memorization, or released-bank access. Zero deterministic joint ceiling is not a stochastic chance baseline.

Registered sites, explicit IDs and inventories, clamped connectivity, guarded inset meshes, and straight translations exclude force balance, clutch strength, grasping, arbitrary poses, and real rack transfer. Public CAD may overlap pretraining.

Pixel distinction and competent study completion do not imply answerability, human-model gaps, favorable rankings, active-view benefit, or empirical superiority. Source-bootstrap summaries remain conditional on retained sources.

The long supplement is a reference census. The chart legend defect P2 remains open. The supplementary chart's DejaVu glyphs are embedded Type 3, not missing fonts; future venue preflight was not certified.
The runtime ZIP is not a full construction checkout. Matching source dependencies and separate policy-host isolation remain necessary.
This is a public preprint with pinned author-kit, not an actual conference submission with a real paper ID. Final committed-byte synchronization and external hosting are outside this review.
acceptance_rationale: The exact-cost/resource/work/repair composition is coherent and auditable, the prior major construction and scoring issues remain substantively closed on unchanged inputs, and the final PDFs and packaged release now have independently checked correspondence. Under the mandated experiment-complete assumption, the design supports interpretable outcomes without assuming any favorable empirical result. Incremental novelty, modest primary visual replication, support-only early conflicts, and empirical uncertainty cap the recommendation at 7. The sole open minor legend defect is compatible with acceptance of this frozen snapshot. The score is an independent judgment, not an arithmetic mean, and does not certify a later commit or official CVPR acceptance.
